2026-09-02-does-4195-s-blank-page-narrow.decision: v17 not promoted; PR #4605 labelled blocked (#4195)
2026-09-02-does-4195-s-blank-page-narrow.verdict: v17 reads the faint-mark page as text on 5/5 runs where v15 said blank, but over-declines elsewhere: a legible Latin note becomes a lacuna.

2026-09-02-does-ocr-prompt-v17-reduce-fa.verdict: Inconclusive: the first-pass cut in fabrication was one draw; two k=5 runs put the runaway repetition loop on opposite arms.

2026-09-02-is-a-similarity-gate-a-workab.decision: prior-art guard made unconditional (declare prior art); similarity list advisory only
2026-09-02-is-a-similarity-gate-a-workab.verdict: No: four rounds of tuning could not get the block rate below about 30% while keeping the true duplicates (0.60 blocks 49%, catching 2/2).

2026-09-03-bench-2-complete-can-self-hos.verdict: Kraken, Surya and CHURRO-3B are statistically indistinguishable from Gemini on pages they read; coverage (25-28 of 56 aligned) is the limit and per-segment n is a pilot.

2026-09-03-bench-2-first-arms-superseded.verdict: Interim: Kraken matches Gemini on Latin and Greek print, loses badly on German Fraktur (72.8-89.1%), and its failures are all guard-visible.

2026-09-05-a-fabrication-detector-that-n.verdict: A reference-free detector flagged 51/51 known recitation pages with 0/5 false positives, but only 56 of 349 pages are judgeable and the highest-risk pages are abstained.

2026-09-05-how-wrong-is-the-ground-truth.verdict: Reference error is 0.07% Greek, 0.06% German, 1.15% Latin; Latin engine gaps sit inside it, and our own reference cleaner cost Greek 6.0% of letters.

2026-09-11-google-cloud-vision-as-a-chea.decision: No routing change; Vision is not a lane for any language
2026-09-11-google-cloud-vision-as-a-chea.verdict: Cloud Vision aligns 37/55 pages vs lite's 52/55, loses where both align, and is the worst Tibetan engine tested; garbles but does not invent.

2026-09-11-music-can-a-vlm-read-shaker-l.decision: VLMs not used on score pages; score against ground-truth first (music-notation.md)
2026-09-11-music-can-a-vlm-read-shaker-l.verdict: gemini-3-flash-preview reads Shaker letteral pitch poorly (interval NER 0.19) and rhythm at 0.49; on mensural staff it read the printed syllables, not the staff (0.42).

2026-09-11-which-languages-can-ocr-on-fl.decision: Routing unchanged (ledger: UNJUDGED); editing the allowlist awaits Derek (#5090)
2026-09-11-which-languages-can-ocr-on-fl.verdict: Of 14 languages with a verdict, German, French and Dutch (routed lite) did not pass and Russian and Armenian (routed flash) did; Latin and Italian were never sampled.

2026-09-12-can-flash-lite-text-only-clea.decision: Not a lane for rejected IA OCR (#4727, #4763)
2026-09-12-can-flash-lite-text-only-clea.verdict: Text-only lite cleanup raises agreement a little (48/60 improved) but lifts no rejected book over the 0.85 gate, costs 86% of image OCR, and invents on unreadable input.

2026-09-12-does-translation-prompt-v15-m.decision: v15 not flipped; v13 stays; v16 also not established (PR #5703)
2026-09-12-does-translation-prompt-v15-m.verdict: v15 lifts verified original-note rate 66.7% to 96.3% but cuts interpretive notes by a third and loses 8:1 to a blind judge; not flipped, v16 follows.

2026-09-13-how-good-is-the-ia-ocr-text-w.decision: Ingester forces offset 0 and refuses non-zero votes (REF_SHIFTED); 236 books to re-pair (#4790)
2026-09-13-how-good-is-the-ia-ocr-text-w.verdict: Delivered IA text in accepted bands has median CER 3.9% vs a fresh lite read, degrading smoothly with no cliff at 0.85; 26% of written books carry wrong-leaf text.

2026-09-13-which-model-should-translate-.verdict: Pre-registration: nine-arm blind-ranking comparison on 60 classical Chinese pages with a fixed decision rule that keeps lite unless an arm beats it cheaply.
Lite and flash-preview are indistinguishable blind (27:26, p=1.0) at 2.2x the price; 2.5-flash is worse (17:33). Lite stays.

2026-09-14-which-model-should-translate-.decision: Lite kept for the Chinese ritual-dance books; pre-registered rule applied as written
2026-09-14-which-model-should-translate-.verdict: No arm displaces lite: preview beats it blind (31-16, p=0.040) at 2.2x cost; Chinese-lab arms write less; the judge's test-retest is only 52%.

2026-09-15-does-any-current-specialist-o.decision: NDL lane unjudged in ledger; Paddle adopted as Chinese cost lane (#4925), no other specialist
2026-09-15-does-any-current-specialist-o.verdict: Only NDL v3 on cursive Japanese beats lite; elsewhere flash-preview > lite >= best specialist, and Paddle matches flash-preview on Chinese woodblock only.

2026-09-15-does-gemini-3-1-flash-lite-re.decision: 18 books held and re-run on gemini-3-flash-preview; global OCR_LITE_ONLY left alone (#4541)
2026-09-15-does-gemini-3-1-flash-lite-re.verdict: No: flash-preview beats lite on 11/11 items; lite loops on 5 of 7 manuscripts and a 1472 incunable and renders long s as f on roman print.
